competitions.result: Fourth round — lost 2–1 away to Manchester United.
Fourth round — lost 3–1 at home to Tottenham Hotspur.
Third round — lost 4–1 on aggregate to Celta Vigo.

overview: Liverpool finished seventh in the Premier League with 54 points during a season of managerial change. Gérard Houllier joined Roy Evans as joint manager in July, but Evans left on 12 November and Houllier took sole charge. Liverpool scored 68 league goals and conceded 49.

Michael Owen led the scoring with 23 competitive goals. His 18 league goals brought a second consecutive share of the Golden Boot, this time alongside Dwight Yorke and Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink. Steve Staunton returned from Aston Villa and Vegard Heggem arrived from Rosenborg. Steven Gerrard made his first-team debut as a substitute in the 2–0 home win over Blackburn Rovers on 29 November.

Tottenham won 3–1 at Anfield in the League Cup fourth round, two days before Evans’s departure. Manchester United eliminated Liverpool from the FA Cup in the fourth round, while Celta Vigo won their UEFA Cup third-round tie 4–1 on aggregate. Liverpool’s largest league win was a 7–1 home victory over Southampton in January.
